AMPL.trigger: staged pullback: half size if $13.85-$14.26 holds on declining volume, second half only on a reclaim of $14.26; a pullback on expanding volume is a hard veto
AMPL.entry_convention: staged fills: half on hold of $13.85-$14.26 on declining volume, second half on reclaim of $14.26
AMPL.invalidation: hard stop at $13.40; close below $12.80 (50 SMA) or any capital-raise/buyback-halt announcement closes the re-entry window
AMPL.horizon: mandatory flat before the Q3 filing
AMPL.reevaluation: balance-sheet stabilization (buyback ended, cash flat-to-up) or broader Street adoption of the $18 target warrants re-rating

ASST.trigger: reassess only if BTC reclaims $83k AND ASST closes back above 29.4 on rising volume; no dip-buying at 26.95-27.40
ASST.invalidation: decisive daily close below 26.95 is a cut-to-zero trigger for any residual exposure; next meaningful support is the 50 SMA near 22
ASST.horizon: 4-8 weeks, or until either trigger level (26.95 breakdown or 29.4 + BTC $83k reclaim) resolves
ASST.reevaluation: BTC reclaim of $83k plus ASST close above 29.4 on rising volume; monitor disclosure of the $855M+ asset base composition and insider Form 4 filings
ASST.ambiguity: the 29.3-29.4 sell-limit with 5-session expiry is stated only for residual/hypothetical exposure; no position is held, so it is not an executable order

CDNA.trigger: stage in only if $59-61 holds on declining volume AND the 10 EMA is reclaimed AND no adverse disclosure on the unresolved $292M investing inflow
CDNA.entry_convention: staged buy zone at $59-61 (Bollinger mid / 20 SMA), added only on hold + 10-EMA reclaim + information confirmation
CDNA.invalidation: if $59 breaks on volume, stay flat and reassess near the 50 SMA at ~$52; for any retained position, stops sit just under the $59 support shelf
CDNA.reevaluation: next 10-Q to identify the source of the +$292M investing inflow; benign explanation plus 10-EMA reclaim upgrades toward Overweight at $59-61
CDNA.ambiguity: sizing stated as ~2% of portfolio in the executive summary/thesis but ~3% in the position-sizing section; stated price target 59.0 coincides with the buy zone and refers to the downside/entry area, not upside

IOVA.trigger: a $13.15 reclaim on expanding volume with a stabilizing MACD permits a 1.0%-1.25% starter; reclaim plus confirmed ESMO data, a clean cash/runway update, or a sustained 10Y pullback permits the full 2.5% speculative cap
IOVA.entry_convention: starter only on technical reclaim; full speculative cap requires the reclaim plus at least one fundamental or macro confirmation
IOVA.invalidation: a daily close below $12.77 keeps the book flat and opens the $11.00-$11.35 gap-fill zone; no averaging down into a break
IOVA.horizon: near term through ESMO; reassess after a confirmed reclaim or catalyst
IOVA.reevaluation: ESMO data, cash/runway update, or sustained 10Y pullback; reassess the $11.00-$11.35 gap-fill zone only if the decline is orderly and unexplained by negative news

MRNA.trigger: (a) pullback to the ~$130-135 50-day region that stabilizes over multiple sessions with contracting ATR permits a ~10-15% starter, scaling only on fundamental confirmation; or (b) disclosure explaining the August 19 repricing permits a small momentum entry sized against post-news structure
MRNA.entry_convention: staged playbook; stop below the prior swing low on the technical path
MRNA.invalidation: a break below ~$182 on volume confirms mean reversion and validates staying flat indefinitely; do not dip-buy the 186-190 zone
MRNA.horizon: event-driven; re-evaluate at the ~132 50-day retest, the November litigation catalyst, or the Q3 print
MRNA.reevaluation: November MRNA/ABUS appeal trial, Q3 print, or fundamental disclosure explaining the 8/19 repricing
MRNA.ambiguity: two distinct trigger paths (technical vs disclosure-driven) with different sizing logic; no single stop price is stated for the re-entry

PGEN.trigger: only on a favorable FDA INO-3107 ruling for PGEN plus a volume-backed reclaim of $7.83 enter a half-normal starter (~5-8% of portfolio); no entry on an adverse ruling or a mere hold of $7.16 without catalyst resolution
PGEN.entry_convention: catalyst-gated starter; scale only after a filing clarifies whether the $55M milestone revenue recurs
PGEN.invalidation: hard invalidation on a decisive close below $7.16; a decisive volume-backed close below it opens $6.62-6.68 and removes even the conditional framework until the trend resets
PGEN.reevaluation: FDA accelerated-approval determination in ~2-3 weeks; CHMP meeting starting ~Oct 12; any dilutive raise announcement triggers immediate reassessment

PTC.trigger: re-engage only if the deal spread widens toward ~$180 or below attributable to non-deal factors, with verified absence of adverse regulatory or acquirer news, sized as a small arb allocation
PTC.entry_convention: small strictly-sized arb allocation only; stops cannot protect against an overnight binary gap
PTC.invalidation: any confirmed adverse regulatory ruling, failed shareholder vote, or Schneider exercising termination rights permanently voids the setup
PTC.reevaluation: any confirmed deal deterioration converts the call to a permanent pass; otherwise reassess only on spread widening
PTC.ambiguity: re-entry requires verifying absence of adverse news, which is a judgment call not reducible to a mechanical price trigger; arb allocation size is not quantified

QMCO.trigger: re-enter only on confirmed stabilization in the 28-30.5 zone with a midline reclaim and momentum follow-through, sized to ~1-1.5% of the portfolio
QMCO.entry_convention: conditional long at the midline only after multi-session stabilization; stop below structure near $25.8 (2x-ATR buffer)
QMCO.invalidation: a clean break below $28.30 targets the 50 SMA at ~$23 and validates staying out entirely; no averaging down into the break
QMCO.reevaluation: a second consecutive positive operating-income quarter plus disclosed, aligned recap terms supports the conditional long; no short recommended on squeeze risk
QMCO.ambiguity: size stated as ~1-1.5% of portfolio in the executive summary but ~2.5% in the position-sizing section; the trader's 28.3 stop is explicitly rejected in favor of ~25.8; stated 23.1 target is a downside objective, not an upside target for the conditional long

SDGR.trigger: re-entry requires actual stabilization: a base forming above $24 on declining sell volume with flattening MACD histogram, or a reclaim of the 10 EMA on accumulation, or confirmed strength after the 11-04 earnings print; no pre-earnings exposure
SDGR.entry_convention: buy the confirmed reaction, not the anticipation; no pre-earnings entry at any size
SDGR.invalidation: a close below $26.87 on heavy volume confirms acceleration toward $24 and then the 50 SMA at ~$22, validating staying out entirely
SDGR.horizon: reassess at the 2026-11-04 earnings print or on the named technical stabilization signals; no fixed holding period
SDGR.reevaluation: 2026-11-04 earnings print; a genuinely positive surprise upgrades SDGR to a re-entry candidate
SDGR.ambiguity: report's entry price 28.5 and stop 30.7 describe an exit/trim scenario for a hypothetical holder, not the stated re-entry plan; no stop price is specified for the conditional re-entry

TEAM.trigger: consider only a small initial position on a decisive close above $202 with volume clearly above the recent 1.7-3.0M-share baseline, adding only after the breakout holds and MACD turns bullish; or after a defended $175.64-$176.42 retest that reclaims the $188 area
TEAM.entry_convention: small initial entry on confirmed breakout or defended-support retest; add only on follow-through, never exceed standard size
TEAM.invalidation: invalidation below $175; sizing must be small enough to absorb a gap through the stop given ~$9 ATR
TEAM.horizon: 1-3 months, reassessed on a confirmed breakout above $202 or a successful retest of the $175.64-$176.42 support zone
TEAM.reevaluation: monitor cash balance, SBC dilution vs buybacks, deferred revenue/billings growth, consumption-pricing transition evidence, and Treasury yields; reassess to Hold only after valuation data is available
TEAM.ambiguity: two alternative trigger paths (breakout vs defended retest); unresolved valuation, insider, and news data gaps justify reduced sizing
